strategies.text:
Overview

Xerneas is a deceptively hard solo due to fairy's unconventionally low damage output. Xerneas does have 1 major weakness in its ability to learn Giga Impact, an abnormally high damaging move allowing for it to be solo'd originally with Necrozma Dusk Mane, and now catch tankable in partly cloudy with Shadow Regigigas. The partly cloudy weather providing boosted Crush Grip & Boosted giga impact damage is critical demonstrating Shadow Regigigas' adaptability.

Est Time to Win: 298.0s - 308.0s


Main Strategy

Context:

There are a couple things to note as preparation. Either Level 40 or Level 50 Shadow Regigigas work. Depending on their defense IV's and or Levels, Shadow Regigigas absorbs 80-85 energy from Giga Impact. Two cases occur:

  1. A 7t catch tank rotation using Hidden Power/Crush Grip (low lvl or low defense)
  2. A 9t catch tank rotation using 2x Zen headbutts/Crush Grip (low lvl or low defense) also involves absorbing a tackle from Xerneas.

The DPS Rotation calculator is a great tool for checking damage absorption values. These two cases will be marked in the battle party. Surprisingly, the level does not affect the CT DPS that much as level 40s trade power for speed whereas the level 50s trade speed for power. Both increase DPS either way.

Mechanics:

TPC with Zacian Crown, careful to track energy gained by Xerneas over time. Catch Tank or opt to absorb 1 Giga Impact on Zacian Crown. Each cycle should be aggressive where 6 giga impacts are absorbed for a total of 2.71 cycles with the last one ideally being energy efficient.

Catch Tank Timing:

Regigigas (when using zen headbutt) needs to absorb the chained tackle after Giga Impact lands. This means out of the 9t window in Giga Impact's animation duration, t7-t8 are the sweet spots to swap into Regigigas. For a Regigigas using Hidden Power, the timings are bit more generous any period from t6 onward is okay.

Zacian Crown:

Zacian Crown gains ~36 energy when sponging a Giga Impact. Overflow occurs when Giga Impact's hit timing overflows when Zacian is holding ~35-55 energy the moment Giga Impact is cast. If this occurs, do not sponge it and catch tank appropriately. Otherwise, it will be mostly absorbed.


As a 6 star level raid, expect this to be RNG reliant. High aggression on 2 of the 3 active cycles is required.
